menu.hangar_desc: Build, paint and name your drones
menu.tracks_desc: Real terrain, wind, weather, FPV gates

hangar.title: Hangar
hangar.sub: The selected drone spins; pick from the strip or add a new one
hangar.empty_sub: Build your first drone with the big +
crew.title: Crew
crew.sub: Your pilots, statistics and default pilot
tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.sub: Real-world location, weather and FPV gates
tracks.no_maps: No Google Maps key — enter coordinates or click the 3D preview
tracks.gates_hint: Click the map or the 3D preview to add gates; drag, reorder, delete (max 50).
tracks.add_gate_hint: Add gate mode on: click the map / 3D
missions.title: Missions
missions.empty: No missions yet. Design your first with the big +: pick a track, name it, draw on the map.
missions.pick_track_sub: Where will the mission be flown?
missions.name: Mission name
missions.outside: Point is outside the track radius
missions.empty_plan: Plan is empty — click the map to draw
missions.no_gates: This track has no FPV gates
missions.gates_order_hint: Click gates to set the order; with none selected the track order is used.
missions.track_missing: The mission's track was not found
missions.hint_corridor: Corridor: click line points; set width in the panel
missions.hint_free: Free: click waypoints in order; drag; right-click deletes
missions.hint_spray: Spraying: click the area polygon; lines are generated by spacing
missions.hint_fpv_flags: FPV flags: click flag points in order
missions.hint_survey: Survey: click the polygon; survey lines are automatic
missions.hint_fpv_gates: FPV gates: click gates to set the passing order
kinds.corridor_desc: Line + width; flight along a line
kinds.fpv_gates_desc: Pass the track gates in order
ops.title: Operations
ops.empty: No flights yet. Make your first flight!
ops.no_data: No replay data for this flight
settings.title: Settings
settings.analog_sub: Analog noise on the camera feed
settings.engine_sub: Soft engine hum in the main menu flight scene
settings.bgfx_sub: Live 3D flight scene in the main menu (turn off on low-end devices)
menu.hint: Click to select · Navigate with arrow keys or gamepad
cookie.title: Cookies
cookie.text: To improve the site we collect anonymous usage statistics with Google Analytics and measure ad conversions with Google Ads (IP anonymised). Loaded only with your consent; you can change your choice at any time.
cookie.necessary: Essential cookies (session, language, theme) — always on
cookie.analytics: Analytics and ad-conversion cookies (Google Analytics, Google Ads)
support.title: Support
support.report_sub: If something went wrong, send it to the Central support team; you will get a reply by e-mail
support.my_sub: Status and replies — fetched from Central support
support.subject: Title
support.body_ph: What did you do, what did you expect, what happened? List the steps.
support.ctx: Include browser/device info and last flight ID
support.done_text: The Central team will reply by e-mail. You can also follow replies in My requests.
support.closed_note: This request is closed; open a new one for a new problem.
support.report_flight: Report a problem with this flight
support.unavailable: The support system is currently unavailable
support.rate: You can open at most 5 requests per hour
airframe.title: Control layout
airframe.classic_desc: Ailerons on the wing, elevator + rudder on the tail
airframe.elevon_desc: Two elevons for pitch and roll (delta / flying wing)
airframe.vtail_desc: Two ruddervators for pitch and yaw; ailerons on the wing
power.title: Power & fuel
power.step_sub: {name} — engine, fuel tank and battery budget; values measured on your last flight are suggested.
power.step_sub_copter: {name} — battery budget (motors + electronics); the average power measured on your last flight is suggested.
power.g_foot: Fuel: distance + throttle · Battery: hourly W + servos · When empty: warning only, flight continues
power.empty_sub: A real aircraft would be in danger — simulation continues (warning only)
power.ev_fuel_empty: Fuel ran out at sim time {t}
power.ev_elec_empty: Battery ran out at sim time {t}
power.written: Saved to the drone, suggested next flight: {v}
power.speedup_used: Simulation speed up to {x}× (times are simulation time)
power.max_speed_hint: Level-flight speed at full throttle; SITL thrust scale + AIRSPEED_MAX/CRUISE
power.consumption_hint: Fuel per km in cruise; full throttle doubles it
power.suggest_apply: Apply the value measured on the last flight
power.sim_speed_hint: SITL time runs faster: fuel/battery and logs use sim time, video stays real-time. Mission Planner sees it fast too.
power.note_measured: Suggested values come from your last flight ({at}); use the badge to go back to the hangar value.
power.note_first: On the first flight values come from the hangar; measured km/L and average W are saved at the end and suggested.
power.measured_title: Measured on the last flight (suggested next time)
power.editor_sub: Hangar values pre-fill the wizard on every flight; measurements (★) are written by the server after each flight.
camera.day_desc: Colour EO camera; the standard view.
camera.thermal_desc: Heat image: engines, vehicles and people glow hot; white-hot, black-hot and ironbow palettes.
camera.night_desc: Image intensifier: green phosphor, gain, grain and halos around bright lights.
camera.applies: The type applies to the gimbal and FPV cameras and to the PiP; follow, free and ground cameras stay in day mode.
camera.keys: T: type · Shift+T: palette · V: PiP · double-click PiP: gimbal
camera.pip_aria: Camera PiP: drag to move; double-click puts the gimbal camera in the main view
camera.pip_title: Drag: move · double-click: gimbal camera to the main view · wheel: zoom
camera.hint: Image type of the gimbal and FPV cameras; change it in flight with the T key.
targets.title: TARGETS
targets.sub: Optional: add targets that keep circling in the sky. Fly into the intercept radius and score!
targets.empty: No targets — the flight starts without targets.
targets.limits: Up to {n} targets · diameter 50–5000 m · altitude 10–3000 m
targets.icept_info: Tailsitter: vertical take-off from its tail, ~400 km/h level
targets.v_speed: speed cannot exceed the model maximum
targets.v_offset: centre offset must be within ±20 km
targets.pv_hint: Drag: rotate · wheel: zoom · double-click: reset
site.title: Ground Control Station
site.desc: A ground control station next to the launch point and a tower carrying Electro-Optics + radar. The radar rotates 360° continuously; the EO tracks the selected target.
site.free_desc: The site is present only as visuals and sensors.
site.defend_desc: Fully manual flight. Interceptors stand ready on a rack next to the station; in waves, targets from random distances and altitudes dive at the station. Launch an interceptor and stop them with the controls; a target that is not intercepted damages the station on impact.
site.seed_hint: The same seed produces the same scenario (replay / comparison)
site.eo_idle_hint: Click a target on the radar screen or press Tab
site.next_title: Deploy the next interceptor to the pad (N) — a flown one is expended
site.next_confirm: Leave the active interceptor and deploy the next one? A flown interceptor counts as expended (the SITL vehicle restarts on the pad).
site.none_left: No interceptors left on the rack
site.ev_wave: WAVE {w}/{n}: {c} threats heading for the station
site.report: Mission report — Defend the ground station
site.from_mission: From mission record: {name} — seed and waves fixed in the record
kinds.defend_desc: Manual defence with an INTERCEPTOR: intercept targets diving at the station in waves. No route; difficulty, waves and seed are fixed in the record.
missions.hint_defend: No route is drawn: the station is set up next to the track centre; choose difficulty, waves and interceptors on the right.
launcher.fire_title: Launch the interceptor along the aim
launcher.ph_armed: Interceptor in the launcher, motors ready
launcher.takeoff_pod: Launcher: GUIDED + ARM; the hatch opens, the interceptor leaves vertically on its tail (NAV_TAKEOFF).
launcher.takeoff_hand: Handheld launcher: GUIDED + ARM; the interceptor leaves the tube and heads along the aim (the aim in the Scope window).
launcher.pod4_desc: Box launcher, 2×2 vertical cells. The hatch opens and the interceptor leaves vertically on its tail.
launcher.pod8_desc: Box launcher, 4×2 vertical cells. In the mission the inventory is spread over the boxes (instead of the rack).
launcher.tube_desc: Single vertical launch tube on a tripod; the cap opens and the interceptor leaves the tube.
launcher.handheld_desc: A weapon-like device on the pilot's shoulder; its small screen shows a sky-facing camera and airborne targets.
launcher.step_desc: Which launcher the INTERCEPTOR leaves from. The tailsitter leaves vertically on its tail; with the handheld launcher it turns to the aim direction.
launcher.defend_note: In the "Defend ground control" mission the loaded cells equal the interceptor count: boxes are set up side by side (instead of the 10-slot rack).
launcher.tube_note: In the mission the 10-slot rack is the spare store; each "next interceptor" is reloaded into the tube.
launcher.hand_note: In flight the "Scope" window shows a camera where the device points and the targets; aim with the mouse, I/J/K/L or the arrow buttons; "Launch" sends the interceptor along the aim.
rcfeel.btn_title: Control sensitivity: per-axis rate, expo and deadband (keyboard and virtual sticks)
rcfeel.title: Control sensitivity
rcfeel.plane_thr: On aircraft the throttle is linear (non-centering throttle)
rcfeel.note: Virtual sticks and keyboard share the same curve; saved in this browser.
gtheme.title: Gauge design
gtheme.sub: Look of the fuel · speed · engine · battery dials at the bottom centre. Change it in flight by clicking the dials or pressing G.
gtheme.classic_desc: Light dial, black needle; car instrument cluster.
gtheme.cockpit_desc: Black dial, white needle and numerals; amber night lighting.
gtheme.glass_desc: MFD tiles: large numeric value and level bar.
gtheme.minimal_desc: Thin rings without background; matches the HUD.
site.win_move: Drag: move · corner: resize · double-click: default layout
site.eo_follow_t: Resume tracking: follow the selected target, auto zoom (double-click)
site.eo_body_t: Press and drag: pan/tilt · wheel / two fingers: zoom · double-click: resume tracking
flt.mode_t: Flight mode (F): available from every camera view
flt.disarm_t: DISARM (X) — on the ground the motors stop
flt.cut_t: DISARM (X) — airborne: the motor is cut and the aircraft GLIDES; control surfaces keep working, you stay in control
flt.confirm_t: DISARM (X) — airborne the motors stop and the vehicle FALLS (asks for confirmation)
flt.confirm: The vehicle is airborne. DISARM stops the motors and the vehicle will FALL. Continue?
flt.cut_hint: You are in control — X / MOTOR ON restores the motor
flt.ev_cut: Motor cut — the aircraft is gliding, control surfaces working
types.rover_desc: Wheeled / tracked UGV: no takeoff, driven with ArduRover
drive.title: Drive type
drive.ackermann_desc: Steers with the front wheels like a car; top speed ~72 km/h (SIM_Rover). Cannot turn on the spot.
drive.skid_desc: Turns by left/right wheel or track speed difference; turns on the spot, top speed ~14 km/h (SIM_Rover skid).
drive.note: A ground vehicle does not take off: ARM it on the flight screen and drive in MANUAL with the virtual controller (W/S throttle, A/D steering, Space stop).
rover.rc_hint: W/S throttle · A/D steering · ↑↓ throttle · ←→ steering · Space stop · Q/E mode channel
rover.no_takeoff: Ground vehicles do not take off; ARM and drive (MANUAL) or switch to AUTO / GUIDED.
power.step_sub_rover: {name} — drive battery (motors + electronics); a fuel tank can be chosen for a combustion vehicle. Values measured on your last drive are suggested.
power.hourly_w_hint_rover: Drive motors + electronics average (sets driving time)
gtheme.none_desc: Gauges hidden for a clean screen; bring them back with the small button or G.
wfx.head: Head
wfx.title: Wind — head / cross / tail components relative to the aircraft nose
wfx.ramp_note: A heading change redeploys SITL with the same settings (~5 s); the angle is applied immediately.
wfx.ramp_locked: The ramp can only be adjusted before take-off (DISARMED, on the ground)
wfx.ramp_hint: Click the ramp: heading and angle
wfx.redeploy: Ramp heading changed: SITL is being redeployed with the same settings…
